# Rimworld Event This is a guidebook to the Rimworld event. You will not be told everything there is to know: some of that is up to you to discover. The point of this guide is to give you enough information to, hopefully, survive and escape.
## Raiding parties Regular raiding parties will be sent to attack the crew's outposts. These parties are not formed of conventional enemies - they're far more armored, and far deadlier. [bold]It is strongly recommended to fortify your outposts to survive these attacks![/bold]
Raiding parties get stronger over time. If you want to survive, stagnation is not an option. See [textlink="the security page" link="RimworldSecurity"] and [textlink="the science page" link="RimworldScience"] for more details.
